# tenferro v0.9.0

v0.9.0 moves the CPU provider stack onto the strided 0.10 / threadteam 0.3
release train, so a fresh consumer resolves `tenferro-cpu` together with
`tcontract` 0.9.1 and `tlinalg` 0.8.1 from one `threadteam` line without a
committed `Cargo.lock`. It also retires the graph AD emitter in
`tenferro-internal-ops`, adds a public `CpuEngine::with_exec` entry,
n-dimensional FFTs, an in-place CUDA dot operand, and CUDA ownership fixes.

## Breaking changes

### The CPU stack moves to the threadteam 0.3 train

The provider stack moves to the line that carries `threadteam` 0.3 and
`t4a-faer` 0.28. A crate that accepts or passes `threadteam::Exec`,
`threadteam::Pool`, `faer` or `strided` types across a `tenferro` boundary
must move to the same line: the two lines resolve as two `threadteam` versions
and the build fails with `expected threadteam::Exec, found strided_basic::Exec`.

| crate | v0.8.0 | v0.9.0 |
|---|---|---|
| `threadteam` | 0.2 | 0.3 |
| `strided-basic`, `-perm`, `-kernel`, `-fused`, `-nn` | 0.9 | 0.10 |
| `strided-view`, `strided-traits` | 0.7 | 0.7 (unchanged) |
| `tcontract-exec` | 0.9.0 | 0.9.1 |
| `cpueinsum`, `cpueinsum-blas` | 0.9.0 | 0.9.1 |
| `tlinalg` / `tlinalg-blas` | 0.8.0 / 0.5.0 | 0.8.1 / 0.5.1 |
| `faer` key (`t4a-faer`) | 0.27 | 0.28 |

The `strided` 0.10 fan-out entries take the `threadteam::Exec` token as their
last parameter and decide their parallel width from it.
([#2366](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2366), background:
[#2367](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/issues/2367))

### The graph AD emitter is retired

Retire the unused graph AD emitter in `tenferro-internal-ops` (library
`tenferro_ops`): the core `ad::linearize`, `ad::transpose_rule` and
`ad::transpose_input` interfaces are removed. Callers of those interfaces
must use semantic-program AD in `tenferro-ad` instead. Linalg operations
continue to use their semantic extension rules.

Preserve the primitive-rule vocabulary at its existing `tenferro_ops::ad::`
paths, including context/shape metadata, support helpers, builder and error
types, transpose-input types and residual declarations. Existing semantic AD
and linalg consumers require no source migration. Core residual-retention
declarations are unchanged; the obsolete function-pointer rule registry is
no longer needed.

See [the semantic AD architecture](../../docs/architecture/semantic-ad.md)
and [#2339](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/issues/2339).

## Improvements

- `CpuEngine::with_exec` lends the engine's full-budget `Exec` for the call
  only, with the engine's broken-engine and retention guarantees, so a
  downstream crate can schedule its own dense work on the caller's engine
  ([#2357](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2357)).
- N-dimensional FFTs (`fftn`, `ifftn`, `rfftn`, `irfftn`) over multiple axes,
  with one optional requested length per axis, through the same single
  execution path as the one-axis transforms
  ([#2365](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2365)).
- Sparse matmul plan construction visits only the entries a left entry pairs
  with instead of every left × right pair, and deduplicates the output
  coordinates once; construction is O(L + R + C log C) instead of
  O(L·R + C·P), with the contribution order unchanged
  ([#2332](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2332)).
- A complex64 contraction prepared under a budget-one token uses
  `FaerLimit::NONE`, with the budget class in the plan-cache key, instead of
  tcontract's packed driver (#2324).
- CUDA dot-general contracts a compact operand where it lies instead of
  staging a fresh compact copy first; only an offset, permuted, broadcast or
  reversed region keeps the copy
  ([#2378](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2378)).

## Fixes

- CUDA einsum materializes ownership copies on the executing engine instead of
  copying through the host ([#2363](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2363)).
- CUDA copies into high-rank destination views directly
  ([#2355](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2355)), and real dot
  conjugation is accepted across the view rank ceiling
  ([#2353](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2353)).
- The zero-order (`ord = 0`) norm counts NaN entries instead of dropping them
  ([#2360](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2360)).
- AD rejects an absent backward gradient instead of falling through the
  retired semantic switch
  ([#2354](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2354)).
- Unused XLA layout conversion helpers are removed
  ([#2344](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2344)).

**Full comparison:** https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/compare/v0.8.0...v0.9.0
